item.title: GlitchRealm v1.0.0 — GlitchRealm release notes: search, reviews, game pages and site updates
item.description: This release improves how search engines and ad crawlers read GlitchRealm, fixes problems with game links, reviews and sign-in, and updates the site's pages, documentation and contributor guidance.
item.content:encoded:
This release improves how search engines and ad crawlers read GlitchRealm, fixes problems with game links, reviews and sign-in, and updates the site's pages, documentation and contributor guidance.

New Features

  • Clicking play should add parameters to the URL — Clicking play should add parameters to the URL
  • Update structural reorganization blueprint to clarify canonical file locations and enhance deployment configuration — Updated structural reorganization blueprint to clarify canonical file locations and enhance deployment configuration
  • Add structural reorganization blueprint for improved project organization and maintainability — Added structural reorganization blueprint for improved project organization and maintainability
  • Update submit game link and add password protection — Updated submit game link and add password protection
  • Update hardcoded game URLs to new domain — Updated hardcoded game URLs to new domain
  • Update footer link to support site and adjust support page content — Updated footer link to support site and adjust support page content
  • Add guest pass button to Smbit game for Glitchrealm with device ID saving — Added guest pass button to Smbit game for Glitchrealm with device ID saving
  • Add legal documentation pages and theme toggle functionality — Added legal documentation pages and theme toggle functionality

Bug Fixes

  • Submit review function causing internal server error — Submit review function causing internal server error
  • Firebase index creation required for reviews modal error — Firebase index creation required for reviews modal error
  • Fix missing guest pass button after merge issue — Fixed missing guest pass button after merge issue
  • Fix navigation and wishlist button issues on game detail page — Fixed navigation and wishlist button issues on game detail page

Performance

  • Optimize performance metrics for Netlify site — Optimized performance metrics for Netlify site

Security

  • Content security policy violation and script loading errors — Content security policy violation and script loading errors

Maintenance

  • Improve GlitchRealm's search engine and AI crawler accessibility — Improved GlitchRealm's search engine and AI crawler accessibility
  • Prerender game content in static HTML so the AdSense crawler sees it — Prerendered game content in static HTML so the AdSense crawler sees it
  • Serve prerendered game detail content to bots via a Netlify edge function — Served prerendered game detail content to bots via a Netlify edge function
  • Game URL not updating after clicking play — Game URL not updating after clicking play
  • Understanding subdomain data access and storage — Understanding subdomain data access and storage
  • Building an analytics system: key components to include — Building an analytics system: key components to include
  • Clarifying if the repo organization is confusing — Clarifying if the repo organization is confusing
  • The AI checkking reviews doenst do anything Ijust tried typing [filtered] and it let it through — The AI checkking reviews doenst do anything Ijust tried typing [filtered] and it let it through
  • Finding solutions for user reviews without sign-in — Finding solutions for user reviews without sign-in
  • URL storage issue with Supabase and Firebase — URL storage issue with Supabase and Firebase
